entities.name: MCH1 (Q6CGU8)
observations: The query sequence is an exact 486-aa match to reviewed Yarrowia lipolytica MCH1; UniProt annotates it as a probable transporter on the vacuole membrane.
A Pfam MFS_1 domain was detected at residues 35–421; UniProt annotates a multipass membrane protein and transmembrane transporter activity.
Fungal homologs from Debaryomyces hansenii and Candida albicans are annotated as probable transporters, supporting conserved transporter-family function; substrate specificity remains unresolved.
